name: Maren Eggert
bio: Maren Eggert was born on January 30, 1974 in Hamburg, West Germany. She is an actress, known for I'm Your Man (2021), Tatort (1970) and Die Frau am Ende der Straße (2006). She is married to Peter Jordan.
